assistant|web_dev_frontend_definition: Front-end development involves creating the user interface and visual elements users interact with, and ensuring intuitive, user-friendly experience.
assistant|web_dev_backend_definition: Back-end development refers to server-side programming, database management, APIs, hosting, security, and scalability behind the scenes.
assistant|full_stack_developer: Someone can be proficient in both front-end and back-end; many developers are full-stack, though it requires keeping up with both fields.
assistant|full_stack_learning_tips: Tips to become a full-stack developer: master HTML/CSS/JavaScript basics, learn a back-end language (Ruby, Python, or PHP), build projects, stay up-to-date, and join communities.
assistant|frontend_learning_resources: Recommended front-end learning resources: Codecademy, FreeCodeCamp, and Udemy.
assistant|backend_learning_resources: Recommended back-end learning resources: NodeSchool (Node.js), Udacity (Python, SQL, Flask, Django), and Coursera (Java, Spring, Hibernate).
